defects.resolution: Authority accepts only exact HumanDecision decision_id + authority_ref + closed structured response; prose never enters privilege semantics.
One-shot authority request/approval is TTL-bound and invalidated on semantic revision, stop, and restart while executing uncertainty remains durable.
Credential/OAuth/SSO, secret-sensitive commands, catastrophic filesystem mutation, irreversible external destruction and supported potentially paid external effects are deterministically gated.
Existing malformed JSON now blocks setup with bounded structured repair guidance and is never treated as an empty config.
Scalar and keyed concurrency/config limits are validated at the CLI boundary before persistence.
Plan/doctor blocked states now carry truthful reason/action guidance; JSONC is classified as unsupported safe mutation rather than malformed JSON.
Profile settings project only the two canonical threshold leaves and accept only low|medium|high.
Nested config resolution is per-leaf; absent/invalid project siblings no longer erase valid host constraints or preferences.
Project routing discovery returns sparse explicit validated overrides and no longer manufactures strategy/list/map defaults.
CompressionArtifact sources must already be explicitly bound to the exact compression consumer scope; cross-task/consumer derivation requires canonical rebind first.
Publishable distribution dependency graph now has canonical root package-lock.json v3 with exact accepted runtime versions and registry integrity.
Notices now enumerate direct runtime SDK, host peer, optional Playwright, build TypeScript, and the audited optional msgpackr-extract install-script boundary.
Canonical check/build runs before a scripts-disabled pack proof; publish also uses --ignore-scripts against the same built tree.
Release SBOM and release-chain verification deterministically bind both root distribution and plugin build/test lock graphs.
Reviewer DONE/prose no longer synthesizes passed review Evidence or closes review/verification obligations without explicit fresh source-bound review evidence.
Passed worker-sourced verification Evidence requires exact worker session plus 64-hex source-state identity; final native diff deterministically binds worker.native_state_hash.
HostPort now exposes Hi-semantic operations/capabilities rather than raw OpenCodeClient or NativeOpenCodeAdapter.
Raw OpenCode event/message shapes are normalized/read at the OpenCode adapter boundary; RuntimeEventController consumes HostEvent and HostPort.
TaskRuntime and ChildExecutionCoordinator consume ChildSessionPort plus host capability contracts; OpenCode child lifecycle is implemented by createOpenCodeChildSessionPort.
Runtime services accept injected process/workspace/browser/child ports; OpenCode adapter construction lives in plugin.ts composition boundary.
ProcessSpawnPermissionError is owned by the generic ProcessExecutor contract, not the OpenCode PTY adapter.
Provider policy parsing moved to runtime/host/provider-policy and model decisions use host-generic reason codes.
RuntimeEventController preserves an already-open canonical HumanDecision instead of classifying USER_ACTION_REQUIRED again.
authority_request requires exact authority_ref + authority-protocol; non-authority decisions cannot carry either.
Runtime reason labels can no longer manufacture authority_request; exact Authority owners create protocol-bound decisions directly.
Local lifecycle receipt now exercises reinstall, doctor and final clean uninstall.
Publishable package now carries executable opencode-hi-setup plus VERSION.
Root package explicitly declares host peer, direct SDK dependency and optional playwright-core runtime dependency.
Mission validator enforces exact task↔worker/parent-session/native-session ownership; callback resolver accepts exactly one native session owner.
RuntimePersistence save/load and MissionStore restore reject duplicate session_id/mission_id identities instead of last-write-wins overwrite.
Unclean restart reconciliation applies to active and waiting-user missions, preserving HumanDecision while resetting/reconciling ephemeral workers/permissions/evidence.
RuntimePersistence rejects unknown/missing envelope keys and malformed timestamps even when schema number matches.
TaskResultReconciler ignores all late results for completed/failed/cancelled terminal workers.
A permission reply observed before its ask makes the later ask stale/idempotent and cannot recreate pending permission state.
Browser sessions are bound to exact execution_owner_ref and stale owners are rejected/reset.
Workspace provision requires canonical Mission-owned exact-Task IsolationDecision.
Kill/timeout semantic flags are committed only after successful signal delivery.
Linux process-group signalling requires independently observed isolated pgrp==owned PID and fails closed on drift.
Different Tasks cannot own the same active workspace path or host workspace ID; collision is cleaned/rejected and persisted duplicates fail validation.

defects.root_cause_record: RuntimePersistence accepted a persisted Mission carrying an unknown identity field.
defects.resolution: Mission identity, intent, and semantic-assessment validators now reject unknown keys.
ProcessRuntime evaluates shell/credential safety before constructing or persisting external-action Authority state.
Authority hashes remain raw-command-bound but pending/executing descriptors are durable-redacted; hash-based completion avoids reconstructing identity from persisted text.
Ledger string payloads are redacted at the durable observability owner boundary before storage.
Secret-bearing executable rollback commands are rejected; durable mutation descriptions and failure details are redacted.
Hi-added Mission runtime system projection is provider-redacted before insertion.
Project/personal/Hi skill candidates are accepted only when the canonical skill directory and SKILL.md remain confined to the canonical discovery root/skill directory.

Repository-local methodology provenance is integrity metadata only; admitted project methodologies default to native ASK unless an exact host/user permission already says ALLOW, while DENY is preserved.
Project methodology policy, skill, provenance and learning candidate files must resolve to exact confined project paths before admission.
Repository fixture roots are derived from import.meta.url rather than process.cwd(); exact same 17 tests pass from plugin cwd and repository root.
Canonical Node harness redirects Hi/XDG state and cache roots to a temporary suite sandbox and removes it; measured HOME Hi-state delta is zero.
Native per-test timeout is 120s and suite process timeout is 300s; hangs cannot block CI indefinitely.
Owned runtime capabilities require active-host health and report OBSERVED only; REAL_HOST_ACCEPTANCE/T3 remains external exact-receipt truth.
Repository-file identity is canonicalized through bounded relative path semantics; absolute, drive, UNC, traversal and NUL paths cannot enter changed-file ownership.
Playwright executable discovery uses explicit/env/platform cache conventions rather than /root or /home/node literals.
Every browser snapshot refreshes and revalidates the actual page URL, preserving dynamic route state and failing closed on external client-side redirects.

defects.root_cause_record: same-server process/workspace health probes were awaited during plugin initialization
defects.resolution: process/workspace health probes are deferred until plugin initialization returns

defects.root_cause_record: fresh-consumer assertion depended on a narrower agent response shape than the native endpoint contract
defects.resolution: acceptance consumes the live agent endpoint and verifies canonical coder projection without invented fields

defects.root_cause_record: initial disk-failure fixture did not force a filesystem write error
defects.resolution: state root is a regular file so persistence deterministically fails ENOTDIR before any committed state

defects.root_cause_record: test planted a synthetic hash rather than requesting the canonical exact action contract
defects.resolution: journey uses requireAuthority and the exact structured authority response

defects.root_cause_record: test confused documented native primitive metadata with a runtime support claim
defects.resolution: journey asserts UNSUPPORTED/OBSERVED plus forbidden fake behavior rather than requiring primitive metadata to be absent

defects.root_cause_record: test assumed the methodology catalog top-level shape and bypassed root-to-plugin architecture script indirection
defects.resolution: journey follows canonical profiles catalog and root npm script to plugin architecture lint owner

defects.root_cause_record: initial workspace child-binding probe used a nonexistent parent session and received native BadRequest
defects.resolution: fresh exact-host acceptance creates a real parent session before the workspace-bound child

defects.root_cause_record: npm 11 multi-field npm view --json emits dotted field keys while the verifier assumed a nested dist object
defects.resolution: registry verifier normalizes npm 11 dotted fields and npm 12 array/nested JSON shapes before exact version/integrity/shasum comparison

defects.root_cause_record: immediate npm view after a successful publish raced public registry propagation and produced a false-negative E404
defects.resolution: post-publish registry verification uses a bounded 12-attempt/5-second retry loop and still fails closed if version/digests never converge

defects.root_cause_record: documentation parity did not reject prepublication npm/bootstrap wording after real T4 publication completed
defects.resolution: current README/installation/release/continuation truth is updated and documentation parity rejects stale npm prepublication wording

claim_boundary: ZERO KNOWN DEFECT means no unresolved defect in the audited Prompt B scope after explicit closure and adjacent re-audit; it is not a claim that unknown future defects are impossible.
